title: When there is no hope, Viator rescues you !
text:
When we had almost given up hope of visiting the Alhambra because all official tickets were sold out, Viator came to the rescue!

The tickets were more expensive than the original €20 price (€60), but still a bargain compared to other alternatives – especially GetYourGuide, where similar tickets were going for an unbelievable €165!

The booking process was smooth, everything went perfectly, and most importantly, we got to visit this incredible place.

Definitely worth it when you think you've run out of options. Thank you for making our Alhambra visit possible!
author: irinab542

title: They Saved My Trip to Granada! Excellent Option and Great Value for Money
text: I purchased my tickets to the Alhambra through this operator with only 15 days' notice. I couldn't find any availability on the official Alhambra website, and I panicked. This operator literally saved my trip to Granada. The service was excellent, and everything went smoothly. I received my booking confirmation and tickets online just a few days after making the payment. An excellent alternative, especially considering the great value for money. Highly recommended!

title: Easy booking to a wonderful place

title: Worth it

title: Alhambra after sunset
text: Private guided tour after sunset. The guide Paula knew how to tell the whole history fascinatingly. In the evening it is also quite quiet, only then not everything is seen.
